# F⃗₃-index of knots

Computed with all tree diagrams with n <= 11: a knot that is not listed has F⃗₃-index > 11 (or is the unknot, index 1).
Knots up to mirror image, KnotInfo names. n = number of internal vertices of each ternary tree + 1. The representative is a ternary tree diagram of F₃ realizing the knot (leaf addresses, 0 = left, 1 = middle, 2 = right).
F⃗₃ is the oriented subgroup of F₃ (Tait graph 2-colourable; Aiello-Nagnibeda, J. Algebra Appl. 21 (2022) 2250139). Knots only occur for odd n. Knots are also listed up to reversal of the orientation, which HOMFLY does not see.
